# autornaR

[TABLE]

## Installation

You can install the development version directly from GitHub:

``` r

# Install remotes if not already installed
install.packages("remotes")

# Install autornaR from GitHub
remotes::install_github("Luiz-Garcia-R/autornaR")
```

## Getting started

New to autornaR? **Start with the [Getting started with autornaR
vignette](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/articles/overview.html)**
for a guided introduction to the package’s main workflow, from data
import and normalization to quality control and downstream analyses.

The online vignette is the easiest way to get started, with step-by-step
explanations and code examples.

You can also access the vignette directly from R:

``` r

browseVignettes("autornaR")
```

Or open the introductory vignette specifically:

``` r

vignette("overview", package = "autornaR")
```

## Input Data Format (Very Important)

To use autornaR, you need two input data frames:

1.  raw_data - raw RNA-seq counts (from HISAT2, STAR, featureCounts,
    tximport, or clean matrices) - Must contain a first column with gene
    IDs - Other columns must contain numeric counts for samples

Example of raw_data:

| GeneID     | Sample1 | Sample2 | Sample3 | Sample4 |
|------------|---------|---------|---------|---------|
| ENSG000001 | 12      | 8       | 15      | 20      |
| ENSG000002 | 0       | 3       | 1       | 2       |
| ENSG000003 | 45      | 50      | 47      | 52      |
| ENSG000004 | 5       | 2       | 3       | 1       |

2.  metadata - describes your samples and experimental groups Must
    contain at least two columns: - Sample: matching exactly the sample
    columns in raw_data - Group: experimental condition

Example of metadata:

| Sample  | Group     |
|---------|-----------|
| Sample1 | Control   |
| Sample2 | Control   |
| Sample3 | Treatment |
| Sample4 | Treatment |

## Main Workflow

The recommended workflow guides users from raw count import to quality
control and initial gene evaluation: - rna_project() - Create a new
rna_project object to store the results from downstream analyses -
rna_import() - Import and validate raw RNA-seq count data (raw_data +
metadata) - rna_normalize() - Normalize data, filter genes, impute
missing values, remove outliers - rna_qc() - Performs comprehensive
quality control (QC) on normalized RNA-seq data - rna_save() - Extracts
and save the essential components from a object

# Exploratory and Differential Analysis

For deeper insights and pairwise comparisons: - rna_compare() - Performs
differential expression analysis (Limma or DESeq2) between two groups -
rna_association() - Compute gene or clinical features correlations among
samples - rna_enrich() - performs Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment
analysis - rna_degs() - Identify differentially expressed genes -
rna_dimred() - Perform PCA and UMAP for dimensionality reduction -
rna_heatmap() - Visualize top variable genes with heatmaps -
rna_gsea() - Perform a GSEA rank to visualize top enriched pathway -
rna_gsva() - Perform a GSVA to visualize individual enriched pathway -
rna_network() - Build a gene-gene network using pathways identified by
rna_gsea() - rna_roc() - Assess discriminatory power of specific genes -
rna_boxplot() - Perform Limma t-tests for gene-level differences -
rna_sets() - Evaluate differential expressed genes distribution -
rna_volcano() - Generate volcano plots for differential expression
analysis - rna_wgcna() - Performs a weighted correlation network
analysis

## Example Workflow (Minimal)

``` r

# Example raw counts
raw_counts <- data.frame(
  GeneID = c("ENSG000001","ENSG000002","ENSG000003"),
  Control1 = c(12,0,45),
  Control2 = c(8,3,50),
  Treatment1 = c(15,1,47),
  Treatment2 = c(20,2,52)
)

meta_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = c("Control1","Control2","Treatment1","Treatment2"),
  Group  = c("Control","Control","Treatment","Treatment")
)

# Create a new rna_project object
my_project <- rna_project()

# Import counts
my_project <- rna_import(my_project,
                        raw_data = raw_counts,
                        metadata = meta_df)

# Normalize
my_project <- rna_normalize(my_project)

# Quality control
my_project <- rna_qc(my_project)

# Dimension reduction
my_project <- rna_dimred(my_project)

# Differential expression
my_project <- rna_compare(my_project,
                          comparison = c("Treatment", "Control"))

# Evaluating top DEGs
my_project <- rna_degs(my_project)

# Performs a WGCNA
my_project <- rna_wgcna(my_project, power = 6)
```

**Note:** The package is primarily optimized for pairwise analyses
(e.g., Control vs. Treatment).  
Workflows involving multiple groups are possible, but most functions
involving measures like log2FC are tuned for two-group comparisons yet.

## Contact

For questions, suggestions, or contributions, open an issue or pull
request on GitHub: <https://github.com/Luiz-Garcia-R/autornaR>

Thank you for using autornaR!

  : autornaR: Quick Reference and Main Functions for RNA-seq Analysis

- [`print(`*`<enrich_result>`*`)`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/enrich_result.md)
  [`summary(`*`<enrich_result>`*`)`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/enrich_result.md)
  :

  Print method for `enrich_result` objects

- [`print(`*`<gsea_result>`*`)`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/gsea_result.md)
  [`summary(`*`<gsea_result>`*`)`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/gsea_result.md)
  : Print method for gsea_result objects

- [`heatmap_result`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/heatmap_result.md)
  : Print method for GO objects

- [`print(`*`<rnaQC>`*`)`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/print.rnaQC.md)
  : Print Method for rnaQC Objects

- [`print(`*`<rnaROC>`*`)`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/print.rnaROC.md)
  : Print Method for rnaROC Objects

- [`print(`*`<rnaVolcano>`*`)`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/print.rnaVolcano.md)
  : Print Method for rnaVolcano Objects

- [`rna_association()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_association.md)
  : Association analysis between genes and/or metadata variables

- [`rna_biplot()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_biplot.md)
  : PCA Biplot with Feature Selection

- [`rna_boxplot()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_boxplot.md)
  : Gene-level comparison and boxplot visualization using limma

- [`rna_compare()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_compare.md)
  : Differential expression analysis using DESeq2 or limma-voom

- [`rna_degs()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_degs.md)
  : Extract and visualize top differentially expressed genes (DEGs)

- [`rna_dimred()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_dimred.md)
  : Dimensionality reduction for RNA-seq data (PCA, UMAP, t-SNE)

- [`rna_enrich()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_enrich.md)
  : Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment analysis for differential expression
  results

- [`rna_gsea()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_gsea.md)
  : Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) from RNA-seq data

- [`rna_gsva()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_gsva.md)
  : Gene Set Variation Analysis (GSVA)

- [`rna_heatmap()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_heatmap.md)
  : Expression heatmap of normalized RNA-seq data

- [`rna_import()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_import.md)
  : Import RNA-seq count data from multiple formats

- [`rna_network()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_network.md)
  : Pathway gene coexpression network from RNA-seq data

- [`rna_normalize()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_normalize.md)
  : Normalize RNA-seq count data with integrated QC and filtering

- [`rna_pick_power()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_pick_power.md)
  : Diagnose soft-thresholding power for WGCNA

- [`rna_project()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_project.md)
  : Initialize an RNA-seq analysis project container

- [`rna_qc()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_qc.md)
  : RNA-seq Quality Control (QC)

- [`rna_roc()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_roc.md)
  : ROC analysis for gene signatures

- [`rna_save()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_save.md)
  : Save a lightweight RNA project for meta-analysis

- [`rna_sets()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_sets.md)
  : Build DEG sets and structured gene membership from differential
  expression results

- [`rna_volcano()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_volcano.md)
  : Volcano plot for differential expression results

- [`rna_wgcna()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_wgcna.md)
  : Construct a weighted gene co-expression network and detect modules

- [`rna_wgcna_metrics()`](https://luiz-garcia-r.github.io/autornaR/reference/rna_wgcna_metrics.md)
  : Calculate WGCNA Network Metrics
